label: Countries
blurb: The list travellers brag about: every country in the world, continent by continent, and the quick trips that tick off three at once.

fields.id: stable slug of the name (never changes once sent)
fields.title: the name people use in English: Wikidata's label, unless that is the formal name (China, not People's Republic of China); other names go in aka
fields.country: its own ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (identity); Kosovo uses the common XK
fields.continent: Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America or Oceania, following the UN's M49 regions (description, not identity)
fields.aka: other names a task might use
